summary:
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)**: Changes `DelphesEDM4HepConverter` output. All tracks that are not electrons or muons now use the pion mass, so energy, mass and momentum are mutually consistent, including jet mass versus constituents. Tracks and leptons now carry PDG IDs, so analyses no longer need to infer particle identity from the mass.
- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)**: Removes the deprecated `inputReader` Python module, which relied on the now-removed `PodioInput`. Steering files still importing it must switch to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.
- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)**: ML fast-shower model initialisation moves from lazy first-inference to before the event loop. Geometry is initialised late enough for DD4hep settings to take effect. The default shower type is now non-hadronic, which changes behaviour for configurations relying on the previous default.
- **[key4hep/DDML#19](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/19)**: Adds a `ddml` Python module providing `ddml_physics`, `add_shower_model` and pre-configured `ModelConfig`s for the bundled models. It replaces the sprawling flag-driven `ddsim_steer.py` logic and gives downstream ddsim steering files a single, streamlined way to set up fast-sim models.
- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16)**: Geometry depth is now a command-line argument rather than a config property, enabling full-depth conversion. Remaining config properties were renamed, so existing custom config files need updating to the new schema.
- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-drs#106](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/106)**: Dataset requests gain a comma-separated Detector(s) field, e.g. IDEA, ALLEGRO, ALFA. It is mandatory whenever the Final Processing Stage is anything other than generation, enforced in the form and on the server, and is included in notification emails.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)**: Adds the IDEA option 2 (`IDEA_o2_v01`) digitisation/reconstruction configuration with a CTest based on the reduced geometry. It is aligned with the latest IDEA_o1 tracking and validation setup.
- **[key4hep/k4Reco#70](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/70)**: The Gaudi KalTest track-fitting machinery now converts `TrackerHit3D`, matching the Marlin behaviour and fixing reconstruction with k4GaudiPandora. Composite space-point hits (e.g. ILD FTD) are not yet handled.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)**: Fixes several problems in the GENFIT track fitter:
  - corrects units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and the z0 conversion;
  - avoids singular initial z0 covariance;
  - builds the AtIP/AtFirstHit/AtLastHit track states via native GENFIT extrapolation;
  - repairs hit–track associations broken during filtering.

Fitted track parameters change as a result.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)**: Fixes boolean properties on the `k4run` command line, which previously could not be switched off because `False` was parsed as `True`. Values must now be True/False, true/false or 1/0, and a bare flag now means True.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#561](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/561)**: Updates HTCondor log/output handling. HTCondor warnings about log-file locations no longer trigger up to 10 spurious resubmission attempts when submitting with pre-EDM4hep-1 stacks.
